note: 2026-09-26 Unit 5 rebuild (user direction: rebuild Units 5-7 through the engine, new photos approved). Learn holds lunch and dinner; breakfast was taught in 4.5 (eat breakfast), so it is a known wrong option, and for is practised in whole sentences. Photos of the same food at two meals differ only in the clock and the light.

lesson.title: 5.7 Meals
lesson.unit_outcome: Name fruit, food and drinks, say what you like, want and need, ask how many and how much, and order politely at a café.
lesson.goal: Recognize lunch and dinner, and say what I eat or drink for breakfast, lunch and dinner and at what time.
lesson.grammar_function: I eat eggs for breakfast. They eat chicken for dinner. They eat lunch at one o'clock.
lesson.prerequisite: 4.5 eat breakfast; 4.10 at and o'clock; 5.2-5.3 food, drinks and drink.
lesson.speaking_outcome: Say what I eat for breakfast, lunch or dinner.
